description: Find paint colours by name or code across all brands, e.g. "Hague Blue", "SW 7029", "agreeable gray", "grün". Matching ignores case and accents ("sniezny" finds "Śnieżny") and every word may be a prefix. Optionally restrict to one brand. Returns name, brand, code, hex, LRV (light reflectance, 0 = black, 100 = white), collection and the colour page url. To match a hex value or a colour from another brand, use find_equivalents instead.

query.description: Colour name or code, or part of it

name: search_paint_colors
title: Search paint colours
